PartBuddy is a free desktop app for designing parts for FDM 3D printing together with an AI assistant, in real CAD.

## What's new

<!-- shot: motion -->

- **Parts that move:** when a design has joints, "Moving parts" above the view shows a slider for each one. Drag it and the parts follow at once; "As designed" puts everything back.
- **Hinges and guides from the assistant:** ask for a lid that folds or a carriage that slides. The assistant builds a print-in-place hinge or a dovetail guide between two parts, with the same gap everywhere (your printer's nozzle, at least 0.3 mm), joins them and sets the limits where the parts meet.
- **Checked through its range:** the ready-to-print check runs every joint to its limits, points at the place where two parts meet too early, and tells you when a part is not standing as designed.
- **Blocks stay with the part:** slots, text, logos and nut traps move along when the part they are on moves.

Hinges and guides are designed to print in one piece and are checked through their range in SolidCraft; they have not been test-printed yet, so print one before you rely on the gap.

PartBuddy is a free desktop app for designing parts for FDM 3D printing together with an AI assistant, in real CAD. This is the first preview.

## Download and requirements

1. **PartBuddy:** download `PartBuddy-Setup-0.1.0.exe` below and run it (Windows 10/11, installs for your user only). The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen warns once: choose "More info", then "Run anyway".
2. **SolidCraft 0.40.0-rc.3:** PartBuddy designs with the free [SolidCraft](https://solidcraft.io) CAD kernel. Install the pre-release **[SolidCraft 0.40.0-rc.3](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/releases/tag/v0.40.0-rc.3)** (on Windows `SolidCraft-0.40.0-rc.3-windows-x64.exe`). The SolidCraft release list still marks 0.30.1 as "Latest"; PartBuddy also starts with 0.30.1, but it is tested on 0.40 only. Designs saved by SolidCraft 0.40.0-rc.3 cannot be opened by 0.30.1 or 0.40.0-rc.2.
3. **An assistant:** your Claude subscription through Claude Code, your ChatGPT subscription, or a local model (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM). The first start walks you through it.

PartBuddy checks for updates through this page.
